report: Revision Kohn-Sham cross-check: Rust solver vs the independent Python reference (different discretisation) on the reference subset
tolerance_rule: |x_Rust - x_ref| <= 3 (U_ref + U_Rust) + 1e-12 scale; U_ref = the reference's three-grid Richardson uncertainty (validated on a fourth grid); U_Rust = (16/15) |canonical - refined| measured per state (checker/rust-refinement.json) or, where `single` does not report the quantity, the matrix-wide maximum of ks-rust-determinism.json; scale = max(1, |x|) for scalars, the profile maximum for profiles. Fixed before the comparison.

checks.name: inputs_all_pass
checks.detail: reference report 28/28 PASS, Rust solver report 40/40 PASS, Rust determinism report 13/13 PASS; failing checks: {'ks-reference.json': [], 'ks-rust-solver.json': [], 'ks-rust-determinism.json': []}; Rust refinement runs (single canonical and refined) failed: none

checks.name: rust_refinement_applies_to_matrix
checks.detail: the canonical `single` runs of checker/rust-refinement.json reproduce the committed canonical matrix (tolerance 1e-12 for every class): E_KS_rel 0.000e+00, E_rel 0.000e+00, emt_integrals_rel 0.000e+00, entropy_rel 0.000e+00, levels_max_abs 0.000e+00, mu_abs 0.000e+00, profiles_max_rel 0.000e+00; hence |canonical - refined| of these runs measures the error of the committed Rust results

checks.name: thermo_state_functions
checks.detail: mu, E, entropy S, F = E - T S, Omega (both forms); U_Rust per state measured for mu, E, S (single canonical vs refined), U_Rust(F) = U(E) + T U(S), U_Rust(Omega) = U(F) + N U(mu); 48 comparisons; worst |diff|/tolerance 338.699 (N8_lamm1_a00_T10 Omega_direct: Rust -1.67909674876244, reference -1.67909675537956, |diff| 6.617e-09, tolerance 1.954e-11); failures: N8_lamm1_a00_T10 mu (|diff| 8.271e-10 > tolerance 7.974e-12; U_ref 2.324e-12, U_Rust 6.513e-16); N8_lamm1_a00_T10 Omega_direct (|diff| 6.617e-09 > tolerance 1.954e-11; U_ref 5.939e-12, U_Rust 1.379e-14); N8_lamm1_a00_T10 Omega_F_minus_muN (|diff| 6.617e-09 > tolerance 1.954e-11; U_ref 5.939e-12, U_Rust 1.379e-14)
checks.diagnosis: N8_lamm1_a00_T10: the 40-digit roots of the Mermin condition on the Rust levels and on the reference levels agree to 4.018e-13 (thermo_mu_high_precision), but the Rust floating-point mu differs from the root on its own levels by -8.267e-10, within the floating-point conditioning bound 1.001e-08 (dN/dmu = 1.242e-06: activated regime) and far above the measured canonical - refined difference U_Rust(mu) = 6.513e-16, because the canonical and the refined runs carry nearly the same rounding error; the reference mu (well-conditioned residual) differs from its 40-digit root by 0.000e+00. Omega = F - mu N inherits N times the mu error. E, S, F and C_V are not affected.

checks.name: thermo_derivatives
checks.detail: C_V = T dS/dT, dE/dT and -dF/dT (Richardson differences in T); U_Rust = matrix-wide relative maximum (16/15) x 5.689e-09 of max(|x|, 1e-6) (refined_heat_capacity); dE/dT and -dF/dT are difference quotients of energies, so each solver's stated noise floor is added: eta_Rust = N x rootTolerance / dT (Rust rootTolerance from its parameters.json, as in its thermo_CV_identity check), eta_ref = N x 1e-12 / dT (the reference SCF tolerance, as in its own thermo_CV_identity check), dT = 0.01 T; 24 comparisons; worst |diff|/tolerance 0.218 (N8_lam0_a20_T50 C_V: Rust 30.2621769061952, reference 30.2621770262547, |diff| 1.201e-07, tolerance 5.511e-07); failures: none

checks.name: thermo_mu_high_precision
checks.detail: mu recomputed in 40-digit arithmetic from each solver's final levels (the Mermin condition sum g f = N), and Omega = F - mu N with it; U from the level uncertainties (mu is a weighted mean of the levels); 16 comparisons; worst |diff|/tolerance 0.038 (N136_lamm1_a05_T10 mu_high_precision: Rust 0.531962420353019, reference 0.531962420353987, |diff| 9.681e-13, tolerance 2.528e-11); failures: none

checks.name: thermo_mu_rounding_diagnostic
checks.detail: DIAGNOSTIC (not a replacement of thermo_state_functions): each solver's floating-point mu minus the 40-digit root on its own levels, against the floating-point conditioning bound B eps_mach N / (dN/dmu), dN/dmu = sum g f (1 - f)/T, B = number of levels (plus 3 U(mu) for the reference, whose mu is a Richardson combination); 16 comparisons; N136_lam0_a15_T50: Rust 1.665e-16 (bound 9.399e-15), reference 5.551e-17 (bound 6.861e-12); N136_lamm1_a05_T10: Rust 0.000e+00 (bound 1.523e-15), reference 1.110e-16 (bound 8.693e-12); N136_lamp1_a20_T20: Rust 2.776e-17 (bound 3.693e-15), reference 0.000e+00 (bound 6.642e-12); N688_lam0_a10_T20: Rust -1.110e-16 (bound 3.196e-15), reference -1.110e-16 (bound 8.634e-12); N688_lamp1_a20_T50: Rust -5.551e-17 (bound 3.528e-14), reference -5.551e-17 (bound 7.015e-12); N8_lam0_a20_T50: Rust 1.388e-17 (bound 1.137e-14), reference 0.000e+00 (bound 6.315e-12); N8_lamm1_a00_T10: Rust -8.267e-10 (bound 1.001e-08), reference 0.000e+00 (bound 1.145e-08); N8_lamp1_a10_T20: Rust -1.388e-16 (bound 4.701e-15), reference -1.388e-17 (bound 6.307e-12); failures: none
